subject: pensions assumed by Social Security
legal_rule: Social Security assumes responsibility for pensions in payment on 31 December 2011 under the substitute banking social-security regime

subject: assets transferred to the State
legal_rule: Ownership of pension-fund assets allocated to the assumed pension responsibilities is transferred to the State

subject: financing obligation of the State
legal_rule: The diploma defines the terms of State financing for the assumed pension responsibilities

subject: covered pensioners
legal_rule: Covered beneficiaries are retirees and pensioners in the substitute banking regime in that condition on 31 December 2011

subject: participating institutions
legal_rule: Covered institutions are banks and other credit institutions identified in the annex

subject: Social Security responsibility
legal_rule: Social Security assumes pensions payable on 31 December 2011 and is responsible from 1 January 2012 for pension amounts corresponding to pensioning of remuneration at 31 December 2011 including Christmas subsidy and 14th month

subject: State financing obligation
legal_rule: The State finances the pensions and administrative charges through a specific transfer to Social Security outside ordinary Social Security Basic Law appropriations

subject: retained bank liabilities
legal_rule: Institutions retain responsibility for pension updates; employer SAMS contributions on retirement and survivor pensions; death grant; survivor pensions to children; survivor pensions to children and surviving spouse for the same worker; and deferred survivor pensions for relatives of current retirees where award conditions occur from 1 January 2012

subject: complementary benefits
legal_rule: Complementary pension benefits remain unchanged and are not covered by the Social Security responsibility assumed under the diploma

subject: asset ownership transfer
legal_rule: Ownership of pension-fund assets allocated to the assumed responsibilities is transferred to the State as consideration enabling Social Security to fulfil the assumed obligations

subject: actuarial equivalence
legal_rule: Assets transferred to the State must equal the value of the responsibilities assumed by Social Security

subject: discount rate
legal_rule: The legal discount rate for valuing transferred responsibilities is 4 percent

subject: male mortality table
legal_rule: Male population mortality table is TV 73/77 minus 1 year

subject: female mortality table
legal_rule: Female population mortality table is TV 88/90

subject: provisional valuation date
legal_rule: Institutions calculate provisional responsibility values as of 31 December 2011 and communicate them to the Ministry of Finance by 15 December 2011

subject: independent valuation procedure
legal_rule: Definitive value is determined by an independent entity contracted by the Ministry of Finance; if the difference from provisional values exceeds 0.5 percent the definitive value is fixed by an independent entity chosen by agreement between the institution and Ministry with remuneration split equally

subject: public debt limit
legal_rule: Transferred assets may be cash and up to 50 percent Portuguese public debt securities valued at market value using the average of the three business days before transfer

subject: first transfer
legal_rule: By 31 December 2011 institutions must transfer at least 55 percent of the provisional present value

subject: remaining transfer
legal_rule: By 30 June 2012 institutions must transfer the remainder needed to complete the definitive present value

subject: provisional 95 percent rule
legal_rule: If definitive value is not yet available by the second transfer date institutions transfer assets needed to complete 95 percent of provisional present value with final adjustment within 30 days after definitive value is determined

subject: coordinating entity
legal_rule: Asset transfers are coordinated by Instituto de Gestão da Tesouraria e do Crédito Público I.P.

subject: extinguishing covered bank liabilities
legal_rule: Transfer of the amounts under article 5 definitively and irreversibly extinguishes the institutions' responsibilities to retirees and pensioners assumed by Social Security and the State

subject: pension payment procedure
legal_rule: Instituto da Segurança Social through Centro Nacional de Pensões ensures payment; institutions process payments to beneficiaries; IGFSS and IGCP transfer required amounts in advance under protocol

subject: tax treatment
legal_rule: Undeducted costs and negative equity variations from transfer are deductible for corporate-tax purposes in equal parts over periods starting on or after 1 January 2012 based on average life expectancy of transferred pensioners

subject: mandatory legal character
legal_rule: The diploma has imperative character and cannot be displaced by collective labour regulation instruments

subject: rights outside transfer
legal_rule: Providential rights and obligations of pension-fund participants and beneficiaries not covered by the diploma are maintained
